# Run comparison view in the Dashboard (side-by-side and diff)

## Description

This epic delivers the core run comparison capability in the Dashboard: users
can select two or more training or pipeline runs and view their parameters and
metrics side by side, with a diff presentation that highlights which parameters
and metrics changed between two selected runs. Today parameters and metrics
live only on per-run pages, forcing comparison in exported spreadsheets; this
epic brings that comparison in-platform.

## Scope

- Multi-select of two or more runs from the existing runs list in the Dashboard.
- A comparison view presenting the selected runs' parameters and metrics side
  by side.
- A diff presentation mode of the same comparison surface that highlights which
  parameters and metrics differ between two selected runs.
- The comparison works over both training runs and pipeline runs, using the run
  data already surfaced by the Dashboard (passive validation of the Data
  Science Pipelines component: no pipeline code changes, the comparison must
  render correctly for pipeline runs).
- No changes to automatic best-run selection, promotion, or cross-cluster /
  cross-project comparison (out of scope per strategy).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given two or more runs selected from the runs list, when the user opens the
  comparison, then the parameters and metrics of all selected runs are
  displayed side by side.
- Given two runs displayed in the comparison, when the diff presentation is
  activated, then the parameters and metrics that differ between the two runs
  are highlighted, and unchanged values are distinguishable from changed ones.
- Given a selection that includes pipeline runs, when the comparison is opened,
  then pipeline run parameters and metrics render correctly in both side-by-side
  and diff presentations.
- Given a selection that includes training runs, when the comparison is opened,
  then training run parameters and metrics render correctly in both
  presentations.
- The comparison is reachable from the existing runs list without leaving the
  Dashboard project context.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P0): Users can select two or more runs and view their parameters and
  metrics side by side in the Dashboard.
- HLR-3 (P1): Provide a run "diff" view that highlights which parameters and
  metrics changed between two selected runs. Consolidated with HLR-1 — the diff
  view is a presentation mode of the same comparison surface over the same run
  data; both HLRs are covered by this single epic at the higher priority.

# Model version to run lineage in the Model Registry

## Description

This epic delivers run lineage in the Model Registry: registered model versions
record and expose a reference to the run that produced them, so downstream
surfaces (such as a comparison opened from the registry) can resolve which run
a model version came from.

## Scope

- Registered model versions capture the reference to the run that produced
  them as part of registration, using the registry's existing extension point
  for structured metadata on model versions.
- The run reference is retrievable through the registry's REST API for a given
  registered model version.
- The exact representation of the run reference (entity, property naming,
  validation rules) is an implementation decision for the Model Registry team;
  this epic fixes the functional requirement, not the data model.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a model version registered from a producing run, when the version is
  read through the registry REST API, then it carries a reference identifying
  the run that produced it.
- Given a model version with a run reference, when the reference is resolved,
  then it points at the correct run within the same project.
- The run reference round-trips through the registry API without loss (write
  and read return the same reference).

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-2 (P1): Registered model versions link back to the run that produced
  them, so a comparison can be opened from the Model Registry. This epic covers
  the lineage half (model versions carry the run reference); the UI entry point
  in the Dashboard registry pages is covered separately.

# Open run comparison from the Model Registry UI

## Description

This epic delivers the Model Registry entry point to run comparison: from the
registry pages in the Dashboard, a user can open the run comparison view for
the run linked to a registered model version, making the comparison capability
reachable from the Model Registry as well as from the runs list.

- In the Dashboard's Model Registry pages, surface the run reference recorded
  on a registered model version.
- An action that opens the run comparison view with the linked run(s)
  preselected, building on the run comparison capability already delivered in
  the Dashboard.
- Works for model versions whose run reference resolves within the same
  project (cross-cluster and cross-project comparison remain out of scope per
  strategy).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a registered model version that carries a run reference, when the user
  views the model version in the registry UI, then the producing run is
  identifiable from that page.
- Given a registered model version that carries a run reference, when the user
  opens the comparison from the registry, then the run comparison view loads
  with the linked run preselected.
- Given two registered model versions with run references, when the user opens
  a comparison of both, then the comparison view loads with both linked runs
  selected and their parameters and metrics rendered.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-2 (P1): Registered model versions link back to the run that produced
  them, so a comparison can be opened from the Model Registry. This epic covers
  the UI half — opening a comparison from the registry; the lineage carried on
  model versions is delivered by the Model Registry.

# Document the run comparison workflow

## Description

This epic delivers user-facing documentation for the run comparison workflow:
how to select runs and compare parameters and metrics side by side, how to use
the diff presentation, and how to open a comparison from the Model Registry via
a model version's run lineage.

## Scope

Content outline (topics to be authored within this epic):

- Selecting two or more runs from the runs list and opening the comparison
  (side-by-side parameters and metrics).
- Using the diff presentation to see which parameters and metrics changed
  between two runs.
- Opening a comparison from the Model Registry: locating the producing run on a
  registered model version and launching the comparison from there.
- Guidance covering both training runs and pipeline runs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Documentation covers the comparison workflow starting from the runs list,
  including multi-run selection and the diff presentation.
- Documentation covers the comparison workflow starting from the Model Registry
  via a model version's run lineage.
- Documentation is technically reviewed against the delivered implementation
  (steps, entry points, and behavior match what shipped).
- Documentation contains no workflow steps for out-of-scope capabilities
  (automatic best-run selection, promotion, cross-cluster or cross-project
  comparison).

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-4 (P2): Documentation covers the comparison workflow from both the runs
  list and the registry.
